name: Nom Nom Edible Co | 200mg Gummies | Bananarama Uplift (4:1:1 THC:CBD:CBG)
description: Introducing "Nom Nom Edible Co's" newest creation: an uplifting treat that elevates your senses and soothes your soul. Our 200mg THC edible combines the refreshing essence of yerba mate with the tropical delight of banana, creating a flavor symphony that delights the palate. Infused with a touch of CBD and CBG, each bite offers a gentle wave of calmness and clarity, complementing the invigorating THC experience. Whether you're starting your day or unwinding after hours, Nom Nom Edible Co provides a deliciously balanced journey to uplift your mood and ignite your spirit.
